sources.observation: The live Komerční banka consumer page describes current KB+ accounts and financial services. Its original paths use #E60029, black and #FFFFFE with a #FFFFFE square perimeter. Official asset and independently rendered full source were inspected. This is the represented operating CZ bank, not a successor substitution.

Current official press-center page identifies itself as Komerční banka's media information, financial results and press releases. It repeats the same labelled header/footer KB emblem and original vector link. This corroborates current use within the same primary publication, not an independent source.
